  
**Registration and Team Formation:**

* Registration fee for each team is 600tk.  
* Any undergraduate university student or college student can register and form a team.  
* Cross-institute teams are allowed.   
* Each team will consist at least of 5 players and no more than 7 players including substitutes. Each team can have a coach but it’s not mandatory.  
* A player can play for only one team.  
* There are no rank limits, players of any ranks can register.  
* Grand Finale will be in LAN and the teams must be present with the full lineup to participate.  
* All players playing in the tournament must be registered through the provided Google Form.  
* **Registration Deadline is June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM.** (Registrations will be closed if 32 teams have been registered)

**Mandatory Guidelines:**

* Teams are required to report 15 mins before their match. Failure to comply may result in disqualification. (This is not a copy-paste rule. We will follow this strictly)  
* Hacking/Exploiting Glitch will result in permanently banned from future IUT Valorant Events.  
* For LAN events, it's imperative that each team member carries their student ID card for verification purposes. Ensure your eligibility by bringing your ID to the event.   
* All teams participating in the LAN event must bring their own keyboard, mouse, headset, and mousepad.  
* In the event of any issues arising between teams, team leaders will be called to resolve the matter amicably.

**Lobby Protocol, Match Setup, and Result Reporting:**

* Every player must join the discord server and be present at the time of their matches.  
* Everyone should wait in the respective discord server game lobby.  
* According to our schedule, one observer will be advocating toss for match selection and sides.  
* After that, all members should wait inside the voice channels assigned initially.  
* There must be a screenshot from every winning team inside the text channel (match result). Only then, they are allowed to leave the voice channel. Failure to do so will result in disqualification.  
* Players will be only allowed to play with the valorant ID provided by the leader while submitting the google form.

**Map Pool :** 

* **All** current competitive pool maps.

**Agents:**

* **All** agents are allowed.

**Format:**

The tournament consists of 32 teams. The entire tournament will be played in a double elimination format, i.e, there will be an upper bracket and a lower bracket. If someone loses in the upper bracket, they will be sent to the lower bracket for another chance. Those who lose in the lower bracket will be eliminated from the tournament entirely.

**Upper Bracket Round 01:** The 32 teams will be paired randomly to play knockout round playing a best of 1 match, resulting with top 16 teams left in the upper bracket. 

**Lower Bracket Round 01:** The 16 losing teams of Upper Bracket Round 1 will play against each other in the lower bracket, where the loser of match 1 and match 2 will play against each other, the loser of match 3 and match 4 will play against each other and so on.

**Upper Bracket Round 02:** 16 teams will then be paired according to the following rule \- Winner of the 1st and 2nd match from the previous round plays each other, then winner of 3rd and 4th match plays each other and so on. This round will follow the same format, best of 1 match, resulting with top 8 teams left in the upper bracket. 

**Lower Bracket Round 02:** 8 losing teams will be sent to the lower bracket. The winner of lower bracket round 1 match 1 will play against the loser of upper bracket round 2 match 8, the winner of lower bracket round 1 match 2 will play against the loser of upper bracket round 2 match 7, etc.

**Upper Bracket Quarter Finals:** 8 winning teams from the previous round in the Upper Bracket will be paired to play Quarter Finals according to the following rule \- Winner of the 1st and 2nd match from the previous round plays each other, then winner of 3rd and 4th match plays each other and so on. This round will follow the same format, best of 1 match.

**Lower Bracket Round 03:** The 8 winning 8 winning teams from the previous round in the Lower Bracket will be paired with each other according to the following rule \- Winner of the 1st and 2nd match from the previous round plays each other, then winner of 3rd and 4th match plays each other and so on. This round will follow the same format, best of 1 match.

**Upper Bracket Semi-Finals:** The winners of QF1 and QF2 will play against each other in SF1, and the winners of QF3 and QF4 will play against each other in SF2. The winners from each of the Upper Bracket Semi-Finals will head to the Upper Bracket finals, and the losers will head to the lower bracket semi-finals. This match will be in a Best of 3 format.

**Lower Bracket Round 04:** The winners of the previous round of Lower Bracket will be paired with the losers of Upper Bracket Quarter Finals. 

**Lower Bracket Quarter Finals:** The winners of the Lower Bracket Round 04 will participate in the Lower Bracket Quarter Finals.

**Lower Bracket Semi-Finals:** The winners of Lower Bracket Quarter Finals will face off against the Upper Bracket Semis losers. The winner from these 2 matches will play in the Lower Bracket Finals. This match will be in a Best of 3 format.

**Upper Bracket Finals:** 2 winning teams from the Upper Bracket Semi-Final matches will play in the Upper Bracket Finals. The winning team will advance to the Grand Finale hosted in LAN in the IUT Campus. The losing team will go to play in the Lower Bracket Finals. This match will be in a Best of 3 format.

**Lower Bracket Final Qualifier:** The winners of Semi-Finals will play against each other in The Lower Bracket Final Qualifier. The winner will proceed to play in the Lower Bracket Finals, against the loser of the Upper Bracket Finals. 

**Lower Bracket Finals:** The winning team will proceed to the Grand Finale. The losing team will be eliminated from the tournament. This match will be in a Best of 3 format.

**Grand Finale:** Upper Bracket Finals winner will face off against the Lower Bracket Finals winner in a Best of 3 match format. The winner will be crowned as the ultimate champion of the tournament.

**Before the match:**

**Check In:**  
All Team members should join their scheduled lobby within time. From each team only one member (preferably the leader) must join the observer channel for the map selection 15 mins before the scheduled time. Toss, map and side selection must be completed within this 15 mins. The organizers or the observers will decide whether or not to allow the team to participate in that match.

**Server selection:**  
Matches will be played in Singapore. But if there is any problem, server changes can be done if both team leaders agree.

**Server Setup:**  
Mode: Standard   
Allow Cheats: Off  
Tournament Mode: On  
Overtime: On

**Map Selection:**  
A toss will be done by the observer. The winning team will ban the first map. The map ban will be done using this website: https://**www.mapban.gg**/en/ban/valorant/all  
Teams will be given their own unique URLs and the rest will be handled there. Teams are highly encouraged to get familiar with the banning and side selection process with default settings.

**During the match:**

**Number of players:**  
A total of 5 registered team players should be present in the voice channel. The benched team members can’t be in the same channel as his team members. If any teams want to use the in-game voice communication, then they should use the team voice instead of the party voice.

**Timeout:**

**Tactical Timeout:**  
Every team will get a total allocation of 2 pauses per game (1 for each half) for tactical reasons, which will be a maximum of 2 minutes. Ask the observer if you need one. Any pauses made without notifying beforehand will result in disqualification.

**Technical Timeout:**  
Every team will get a total allocation of 1 pause per game for technical issues which will be a maximum of 5-8 minutes. Ask the observer if you need one. Any pauses made without notifying beforehand will result in disqualification.

**Screenshot and MOSS Submission:**

The winning captain needs to post a screenshot of the end game scoreboard and the MOSS zip file of each of the players on discord on the designated channel. A match’s result will not be official and recorded till the screenshot is posted by the winning team’s captain. Failure to provide the MOSS zip file of each player will result in disqualification.

**Toxicity:**

To ensure a positive and respectful environment, NO TOXICITY is allowed in chat and in game, if noticed the team will get disqualified. Offensive Language might lead you to a ban from our tournament.  It is essential for all participants to demonstrate good sportsmanship and cooperative behavior for a healthy competition.

**RuIes Changes:**

The Tournament administration reserves the right to amend, remove, or otherwise change the rules outlined in this Rulebook, without further notice. The Tournament administration also reserves the right to make a judgment on cases that are not specifically supported or detailed in this Rulebook or to make judgments that even go against this Rulebook in extreme cases, to preserve fair play and sportsmanship.
